title: A GREEN GATE OPENS THE TEST — IT DOES NOT ANSWER IT
semantic_thesis: A trustworthy benchmark system must pass its own admission and attribution gates before its subject can be scored. Passing those gates means the instrument is ready and refuses false conclusions; it does not mean the subject has already passed the benchmark datasets that have not yet been executed.

ru: Зелёный измеритель открывает испытание, но не отвечает вместо испытуемого.
Сто тестов в проверяемом реестре — это сто определённых целей, а не сто автоматически засчитанных побед.
Сначала мы доказали, что прибор умеет сказать «не могу измерить» вместо выдуманного результата; теперь можно честно требовать от Януса ответов.
Слитый benchmark harness — начало измерения, а не сертификат интеллекта.
Результат должен родиться там, где реально встретились frozen dataset, исполнитель и grader.
en: A green measuring instrument opens the trial but does not answer for the subject.
One hundred tests in a verifiable registry are one hundred defined targets, not one hundred automatically credited victories.
First the instrument proved it can say cannot measure instead of inventing a result; now Janus can be asked for actual answers honestly.
A merged benchmark harness is the beginning of measurement, not a certificate of intelligence.
A score must be born where the frozen dataset, executor and grader actually meet.

next_semantic_question: When a composite Janus configuration receives a real score, which part of that score belongs to the provider model, which to Genesis orchestration, and which to the external execution environment?
boundary: Semantic systems-evaluation interpretation only. No official top-100 benchmark accuracy, AGI, consciousness, model superiority or independent scientific validation is claimed.
